title: Elephant reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Elephant body -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='66' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#8fa6c9'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='78' width='9' height='14' rx='3' fill='#7a90b3'/>
  <rect x='52' y='78' width='9' height='14' rx='3' fill='#7a90b3'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='18' fill='#a3b8d8'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='40' rx='10' ry='13' fill='#8fa6c9'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='40' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#d8a9bc'/>
  <!-- Trunk curling down toward book -->
  <path d='M78 50 Q88 58 84 72 Q82 80 74 80' stroke='#a3b8d8' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tusk -->
  <path d='M74 56 Q80 60 78 66' stroke='#f5f0d6' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eye (happy) -->
  <path d='M66 40 Q69 37 72 40' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <path d='M20 70 L48 64 L48 82 L20 88 Z' fill='#e0705f'/>
  <path d='M48 64 L76 70 L76 88 L48 82 Z' fill='#f08a72'/>
  <path d='M48 64 L48 82' stroke='#c85a48' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Book lines -->
  <line x1='25' y1='74' x2='43' y2='70' stroke='#fbe3b0' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='25' y1='79' x2='43' y2='75' stroke='#fbe3b0' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='70' x2='71' y2='74' stroke='#fbe3b0' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='75' x2='71' y2='79' stroke='#fbe3b0' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M18 64 Q10 60 12 52' stroke='#7a90b3' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='51' r='3' fill='#d8a9bc'/>
</svg>
